data.title: Rebuild frog swing silhouette and eye anchors
data.description: Review the committed bn-2tc diff. Focus on sprite consistency in live swing captures, correct mirrored eye/lens and active beam anchoring, preserved mutation hit behavior, authoritative cart/project/source synchronization, and regression coverage. Full just check passes.

data.body: HIGH: @swing_tuck is byte-for-byte identical to @idle. Reproduction: dump frog.idle and frog.swing_tuck with 'console sprite dump' and cmp returns 0 (the 24 rows at lines 138-161 exactly match idle lines 8-31). The runtime selects this frame for a slow/reelled latch, so 01-swing-tuck.png shows the grounded idle silhouette hanging from the tongue instead of the compact/tension pose promised by ART-BIBLE.md. Please author a distinct tuck with raised/bent hind-leg or torso tension while preserving the new chunky mass, and add a regression that requires swing_tuck to differ meaningfully from idle; the current opaque-area/bounds checks accept an exact duplicate.

MEDIUM: The added coordinate regression covers only the persistent idle lens, not the active laser-beam roots introduced by player_laser_origin(). The playtest fires after pump_left, and dev_stage_actor_review does not reset facing, so the single recoil capture exercises only the left-facing attack; captures are not pixel assertions anyway. Please expose/assert the two active roots against the authored laser_brace eyes for both facing directions (a draw-trace or focused dev probe is sufficient), while retaining the existing mutation-hit test for the unchanged combat ray.

data.reason: The low-speed swing frame is an exact copy of idle, so the central suspended-pose requirement is not met; active beam-origin regression coverage also needs completion.

data.body: Fixed: @swing_tuck is now a distinct suspended pose with the established head/body mass but folded, raised hind legs and no planted baseline. Regression requires >=30 pixel differences from idle and at most four opaque bottom-row pixels. Live grapple capture inspected.

Fixed: dev_render_laser_probe draws the production brace before/after the active effect, verifies both authored white-eye centers and both beam-core roots for right and mirrored-left facings. Correct roots are facing dependent; the insect-hit regression remains unchanged and green.

Verified in 3aaca04: the tuck differs from idle by 67 pixels, removes the planted baseline, retains the chunky head/body, and reads as a folded suspended pose in the live 01-swing-tuck capture. Focused regression enforces both distinctness and tucked feet.

Verified in 3aaca04: dev_render_laser_probe samples authored white eye pixels and post-effect root inks at right roots 42,24/48,24 and mirrored-left roots 31,24/37,24. Both directions pass; live recoil is aligned and the unchanged insect-hit test remains green.

data.reason: Fixes verified: distinct live tuck silhouette, mirrored active eye-root probes, synchronized assets, and preserved laser-hit behavior.
